payload.notes: MiniMax M2.7 REAP AutoRound W4A16 run on 4x Intel Arc Pro B70 via vLLM/XPU TP4. This supersedes the corrected greedy REAP baseline cmpuc7tkq00qamq01z61pnb3c. New easy win: force oneCCL Level Zero IPC to pidfd with CCL_IPC=pidfd and CCL_ZE_IPC_EXCHANGE=pidfd while keeping CCL_TOPO_FABRIC_VERTEX_CONNECTION_CHECK=0. Quality gate with explicit pidfd passed: /mnt/fast-ai/bench-results/minimax-m27-reap-autoround-vllm/quality/quality-smoke-20260531T231727Z.json reports passed=true, deterministic output, 1473 generated tokens, and no NUL/control/degenerate output. Same-window p512/n1536 screen: pidfd 89.427389, pidfd repeat 89.326898, default IPC control 89.275803, sockets 88.904930, promoted config 89.499223 output tok/s. No speculative decoding, no expert dropping, no router approximation, no power-limit change.
